mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by >1% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY decline > 2% and UNRATE > 8% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real estate sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines YoY by >5% for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month for 3 consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines MoM for 3 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year and industrial production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a stagflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY rise > 3% and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY rise > 3% and INDPRO declining but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY rise > 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
